newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia still driving Helsinki to all-time highs.
newsitem.headline: Nokia still driving Helsinki to all-time highs.

text.p: Shares powered to all-time highs in heavy trade for a third straight session on Wednesday, as Nokia rose sharply on a buy recommendation from U.S. investment house Smith Barney, brokers said.
The FOX stock futures index gained 1.37 percent to 1,102.48, while the all-share HEX rose 1.51 percent to 3,226.17 points.
"Nothing seems to be holding us," one broker said, adding overall liquidity remains good and trade has been unusually lively for the week after the midsummer holiday.
Nokia ended up 13.00 markka at a life-high 393.00 in heavy 310 million markka volume.
Brokers said they were still watching for Nokia to hit 400 markka soon, and Smith Barney set a $114 target price for Nokia over the next 18 months.
Bullish sentiment was widespread and drawing particularly foreign investors, brokers said. "It seems that no matter what the share, it's been tasty," one said.
Forestries were strong, helped by a pulp price hike announcement on Tuesday from Sweden's Stora.
UPM ended 0.90 markka higher at 122.90 after touching 123.50 in sturdy 40 million markka volume. Enso tacked on 0.60 to 48.50.
